import re

HDR = re.compile(r'^(?:"(?P<name>.*)"\s+)?(?:#(?P<num>\d+)\s+)?(?:\[(?P<ostid>\d+)\]\s+)?(?P<daemon>daemon\s+)?(?:prio=(?P<prio>\d+)\s+)?os_prio=(?P<os_prio>-?\d+)(?:\s+cpu=(?P<cpu>\S+))?(?:\s+elapsed=(?P<elapsed>\S+))?\s+tid=(?P<tid>\S+)\s+nid=(?P<nid>\S+)\s*(?P<status>.*?)\s*(?:\[(?P<addr>0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)\])?\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    info = {}
    ilines = []
    threads = []
    tlines = []
    frames = []
    flines = []
    jni = {}
    jlines = []
    skip = []
    cur = None
    in_smr = False
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if in_smr:
            skip.append(i)
            if s.startswith('}'):
                in_smr = False
            continue
        if s.startswith('Threads class SMR info'):
            in_smr = True
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'Full thread dump (.*?):?$', s)
        if m:
            info['JVM'] = m.group(1)
            ilines.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d$', s):
            info['Timestamp'] = s
            ilines.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'JNI global refs: (\d+), weak refs: (\d+)', s)
        if m:
            jni['JNI global refs'] = int(m.group(1))
            jni['weak refs'] = int(m.group(2))
            jlines.append(i)
            continue
        m = HDR.match(l)
        if m:
            cur = {
                'Name': m.group('name') or '',
                'Number': m.group('num') or '',
                'OS thread id': m.group('ostid') or '',
                'Daemon': 'yes' if m.group('daemon') else 'no',
                'prio': m.group('prio') or '',
                'os_prio': m.group('os_prio'),
                'cpu': m.group('cpu') or '',
                'elapsed': m.group('elapsed') or '',
                'tid': m.group('tid'),
                'nid': m.group('nid'),
                'Status': m.group('status') or '',
                'Address': m.group('addr') or '',
                'State': '',
            }
            threads.append(cur)
            tlines.append(i)
            continue
        if cur is not None and l[:1] in (' ', '\t'):
            m = re.match(r'java\.lang\.Thread\.State: (.*)$', s)
            if m:
                cur['State'] = m.group(1)
                tlines.append(i)
                continue
            m = re.match(r'at (.*)$', s)
            if m:
                kind, detail = 'at', m.group(1)
            else:
                m = re.match(r'- (\w[\w ]*?)\s+(<.*)$', s)
                if m:
                    kind, detail = m.group(1), m.group(2)
                else:
                    m = re.match(r'- (.*)$', s)
                    if m:
                        kind, detail = '-', m.group(1)
                    else:
                        kind, detail = 'info', s
            frames.append({'Thread': cur['Name'], 'tid': cur['tid'], 'Kind': kind, 'Detail': detail})
            flines.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if info:
        blocks.append({'name': 'dump', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': ilines, 'records': [info]})
    if threads:
        blocks.append({'name': 'threads', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': tlines, 'records': threads})
    if frames:
        blocks.append({'name': 'stack_frames', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': flines, 'records': frames})
    if jni:
        blocks.append({'name': 'jni_refs', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': jlines, 'records': [jni]})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
